items.heading: Yes, But the Honest Answer
items.text: Yes, but the honest answer splits sharply by who is asking, and most generic articles on this topic skip that split entirely.

items.heading: A Distance or Online MBA
items.text: A distance or online MBA is a management degree delivered without requiring regular physical attendance at a campus. Course material, assignments, and exams are handled through printed material, an online learning portal, recorded or live lecture sessions, or some mix of the three, depending on the specific university and program.

items.heading: In India, Distance and Online
items.text: In India, distance and online higher education is regulated by the UGC's Distance Education Bureau (DEB) under the UGC (Open and Distance Learning Programmes and Online Programmes) Regulations, 2020. A university needs specific "entitlement" from DEB, granted separately for Open and Distance Learning (ODL) mode and for fully Online mode, and that entitlement is program-specific and renewed each academic session, not a one-time, permanent approval.

rows: IGNOU, Annamalai University, University of Madras

Widest recognition for government and PSU eligibility criteria, decades of ODL track record, and the lowest fees in the market. Curriculum delivery is more self-study and print/portal-material heavy than the newer online-only programs.
Symbiosis Centre for Distance Learning (SCDL), Welingkar Institute (WeSchool), ICFAI University
Backed by an established on-campus B-school brand, with more structured contact sessions than pure ODL. Fees sit above public universities but well below the fully online private-university tier.
Amity University Online, NMIMS Global, Manipal University Jaipur, Lovely Professional University (LPU) Online

Live/recorded lecture platforms, structured semester batches, and more visible placement-support pages. Fees are the highest in this list, and quality varies more by specific program entitlement than by university name alone.
